_doc: A scripted duel that looks like real play: the charge-in and salute, then ten passes. Each pass is one beat of the simple duel (carriages apart -> charge in with both moves starting as the carriages leave -> the arms pull back and rest -> carriages apart). Every contact pass is a pair with a saved calibration in sim/contact_stops.json; the others are misses by design (docs/collision_intent.md). Run with arm/duel_sequence.py.

opener.note: charge in together, then both salute: blade up, then levelled at each other

passes.note: A opens with the overhead chop; B takes it on the level bar (blocked, riposte for B)
B answers in kind: chop on A's bar (blocked)
A fakes the chop; B's guard is exposed (no contact)
A goes low while B is still guarding high: the slash lands (wrong guard, no contact)
B's backhand sweep, stopped by A's right-side hanging guard
both chop at once: the high bind, blades crossed above the centre (clash)
A's low feint is caught by B's real sweep (feint punished)
two sweeps from opposite sides end crossed in an X ahead of the hilts (clash)
B chops over A's low guard: the tip taps A's sword hand (wrong guard)
the finisher: B feints, A's backhand sweep catches the cocked blade (feint punished)
